text:
Maya: Quick check — launch week schedule question: do we send the webinar invite in the Day 2 newsletter or hold for Day 4? Goal is to maximize demo signups without hurting open rates. :thinking:
Jasper: my vote Day 2. early invite captures higher-intent readers. can we soft-seg to "high-engagers" only? @Maya
Emi: Agree Day 2 for engaged cohort. For cold list (inactive_30d) hold to Day 4 with a warmer subject. Also we need timezone staggering for APAC to avoid overnight drops.
Tom: +1 Day 2 for trialers and engaged. For staging here's the proposed send timing (local targs):
```
NA: send 10am local (Day 2)
EU: send 10am local (Day 2, +1hr shift window)
APAC: send 11am local (stagger to Day 3 for deliverability)
```
Leah: FYI the webinar landing page is updated — https://redwood.ai/webinar-benchmark-launch (tracking params ready).
Maya: can product ops add the webinar tag to the trialer segment? @Leah
Leah: done. added tag "bench-webinar-invite" to trialers and updated segment query to exclude enterprise-only reps.
Jasper: A/B subject test proposals:
A) "See the benchmark + join our live walk-through"
B) "Live: How we cut serving cost 2x — webinar"
Emi: run 50/50 across the engaged cohort, 20/80 for trialers (favor B). track CTR -> register rate and post-webinar demo requests.
Tom: also recommend a secondary CTA in the footer: "Request Dedicated pricing" for enterprise-y leads, routed to sales@redwood.ai.
Maya: updated send doc: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/benchmark-launch-sends — please review by EOD. Quick checklist in the sheet: segments, subject A/B, CTAs, timezone windows, suppression lists.
deploy-bot: Campaign "Benchmark Launch — Newsletter Week" scheduled for 2026-02-18 16:00 UTC.
Maya: :thumbsup: Thanks team. I'll confirm final segment lists in the sheet and lock the audience at 11:30 PST tomorrow.
